title: Elderly Trio Dressed Up Outside Stucco Home, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black-and-white snapshot depicting three well-dressed older adults posed outside against the textured stucco exterior of a residential home. The house features Spanish or Mission-style elements, including decorative roof edging and striped canvas awnings over the windows. The man wears a tailored wool suit with spectacles, while the woman in the center wears an elegant 1940s dress and heeled shoes, and the older woman on the right wears a formal dark dress with a pale brooch or collar.
